title: Denominator bounds for raw resolution cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], $F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $q\in\mathbb N$, $W$ an affine open of $T$, and $a\in\Gamma(T,W)$. Let $P=\operatorname{sectionCohomologyPresheaf}(f_*I,q)$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], and let $r$ denote restriction from $W$ to $D(a)$; write $a_D$ for restriction of the scalar $a$ to $D(a)$. For every $s\in P(D(a))$ there exist $n\in\mathbb N$ and $t\in P(W)$ such that $r(t)=a_D^n\cdot s$.

source.place: Tag 09MR (lemma-invert-s-cohomology), tensor-unit specialization, surjectivity; Tag 01E4, resolution/evaluation comparison.

proof.text: Put Y=f⁻¹W and b=f^♯a. Y is qcqs and the restriction G of F is quasi-coherent. Restriction preserves injective resolutions. Evaluation of f_*I at W and D(a) is sections of I on f⁻¹W and f⁻¹D(a)=D(b), respectively. Exact evaluation commutes with homology, identifying P restriction and scalar actions with the corresponding cohomology restriction and pulled-back scalar actions.

Apply invertS_cohomology on Y with L=O_Y and section b. Canonical unitors identify G tensor L^{tensor i} with G; tensorPowSection of b induces multiplication by b^i on cohomology. Thus the fraction relations read [i,x]=[i+k,b^k x].

Represent the inverse image of s under the fraction equivalence by a finite sum of generators. Choose n at least their indices, replace every [i,x] by [n,b^{n-i}x], and add numerators to obtain [n,t]. The canonical numerator equation gives b^n s=res(t). Transport through the resolution identifications and commute restriction with powers, obtaining r(t)=a_D^n s. Empty opens, a=0, units and degree zero are included.

proof_origin.place: Tensor-unit specialization of the canonical comparison; resolution computation from Tag 01E4.

lean.statement: theorem sectionCohomologyPresheaf_clearDenominators {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ) (W : T.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (a : Γ(T, W)) : let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q ∀ s : P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a)), ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : P.obj (op W)), (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom t = (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op a) ^ n • s
